title: Feature request : Color lines in treatments
body:
It would help the users know what these colors are
![Screenshot_20250615_112153_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b6067388-a816-4fb7-9980-fe1585276c2d)
if the equivalent line in the treatments running mode tab had the same color.
![Screenshot_20250615_112243_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4ed4a8d4-48e9-4e90-b695-cda56387a74d)

Maybe (also ?), a tap on the colored bar on the UI can have an explanation pop-up to tell what the color means.

If not, we'll have to answer the same questions over and over in Discord... 🫣

comments.body: I think color line on the top should be the same than loop icon: green for close loop, blue for open loop, grey for pump disconnected, red for loop suspended, dotted line green (or darker green in dark theme) for LGS mode...

Yes, sounds logical. I don't know what the actual colors mean. Only had red (time before the update) and yellow (pump change).

I vote against the **green line** though. The UI would be cleaner if there were no lines if loop is working normally (closed loop, which is 99% of the time I suppose) and show a color only when it is not.
Green line for closed loop was left out intentionally to avoid cluttering up graph when loop is in normal state. But I think it's a nice improvement to add text when you tap the color-lines :)
